mapper.sql: select mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.request_no, su.user_name, mo.user_id, mo.assigned_agent_id, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, mo.total_count, mo.success_count, mo.failed_count, mo.total_amount, mo.refund_amount, mo.order_status, mo.completed_time, mo.create_by, mo.create_time, mo.update_by, mo.update_time, mo.remark, ( select moi.phone from mark_order_item moi where moi.order_id = mo.id order by case when moi.process_status = '0' then 0 else 1 end, moi.id asc limit 1 ) as phone_preview from mark_order mo left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
mapper.select:
select mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.request_no, su.user_name, mo.user_id, mo.assigned_agent_id, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, mo.total_count, mo.success_count, mo.failed_count, mo.total_amount, mo.refund_amount, mo.order_status, mo.completed_time, mo.create_by, mo.create_time, mo.update_by, mo.update_time, mo.remark, moi.phone as phone_preview from mark_order mo left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id inner join mark_order_item moi on moi.order_id = mo.id
and mo.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and mo.request_no like concat('%', #{requestNo}, '%')
and ( mo.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or su.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or moi.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and mo.user_id = #{userId} and mo.assigned_agent_id = #{assignedAgentId} and mo.platform_code = #{platformCode} and mo.order_status = #{orderStatus} and moi.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and mo.create_time >= #{params.beginTime}
and mo.create_time <= concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by mo.create_time desc, moi.id asc
